capabilities: Save a note as an MP3 with an embed
Control playback from the status bar or a floating player
Pick a voice and playback speed
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. A free plan includes a monthly character allowance; each character listened to or saved uses one credit. The API key is stored in Obsidian's keychain and may be unencrypted on systems without a secret store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to a note or turn it into an audio file.

relations.evidence: The plugin turns text into speech on Lazybird's servers.

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads notes or selections aloud and saves notes as MP3 files using Lazybird's cloud voices.
